actions.name: ai_settings_get
actions.desc: Get the org's AI meter for the caller: whether AI tools are enabled, monthly token cap and usage, the caller's daily request allowance, plus can_edit (admin) / can_view_usage (admin/manager). Any staff.

actions.name: ai_settings_set
actions.desc: Change the org's AI tool settings. Admin only. p_patch keys: enabled (bool), monthly_token_cap (tokens/month), member_daily_requests (per-person daily request limit). Returns the updated meter.

actions.name: ai_usage_summary
actions.desc: AI usage breakdown for the org over the last p_months (1-12, default 6): meter, usage by action, by member and by month. Admin/manager only.

actions.name: sevak_context
actions.desc: Who is asking (name, role), org name, Sevak's office notes, today's IST date, and the org's clients and team (ids). Any staff.

actions.name: sevak_notes_set
actions.desc: Save the org's plain-English 'things Sevak should know about our office' notes (max 8000 chars). Admin only.

actions.name: task_ai_fields_get
actions.desc: Get the stored AI-generated fields for a task: {summary?, progress?}. Any staff who can see the task.

actions.name: automation_create_from_template
actions.desc: Create an automation rule from a built-in template (p_key = template key, see automation_templates). Admin/manager only. p_overrides keys: name, enabled, scope_type, scope_id, trigger_config, conditions, actions.

actions.name: automation_delete
actions.desc: Permanently delete an automation rule by id. Admin/manager only.

actions.name: automation_duplicate
actions.desc: Copy an existing automation rule (new rule starts disabled-safe as a copy, named 'copy'). Admin/manager only. Returns the new rule.

actions.name: automation_get
actions.desc: Get one automation rule (trigger, conditions, actions, scope, run stats) by id. Admin/manager only.

actions.name: automation_meta
actions.desc: Metadata for the automation builder: available trigger types, action types, enabled features (WhatsApp, forms, invoices, email), task templates and recurring tasks, and whether the caller can manage rules. Any staff (can_manage = admin/manager).

actions.name: automation_outbox_list
actions.desc: List recent outbound webhook/email deliveries queued by automations (status, attempts, errors), newest first, up to p_limit. Admin/manager only.

actions.name: automation_quick_list
actions.desc: List the one-click 'quick automations' for a client (p_client_id) with whether each is switched on. Admin/manager only.

actions.name: automation_quick_set
actions.desc: Switch a quick automation (p_key from automation_quick_list) on or off for one client (p_client_id, p_on). Creates the client-scoped rule from its template on first enable. Admin/manager only.

actions.name: automation_run_now
actions.desc: Run a saved automation rule's actions right now, optionally against a task (p_task_id); conditions are still checked unless p_force=true. Admin/manager only; can send messages/emails/webhooks if the rule's actions do.

actions.name: automation_runs_list
actions.desc: Automation run history (status success/partial/failed/skipped, errors, task). Admin/manager only. p_filter keys: rule_id, task_id, status, since (timestamp), limit.

actions.name: automation_templates
actions.desc: List the built-in automation templates (key, name, description, trigger, actions, whether it is a per-client quick toggle). Any staff.

actions.name: automation_test
actions.desc: Dry-run an automation rule definition against a task (p_task_id): validates the rule and reports whether its conditions match; no side effects. Admin/manager only. p_data has the same keys as automation_upsert (trigger_type, conditions, condition_match, actions, scope_type, scope_id, trigger_config).

actions.name: automation_toggle
actions.desc: Enable or disable an automation rule (p_id, p_enabled). Admin/manager only. Returns the rule.

actions.name: automation_upsert
actions.desc: Create or update an automation rule (pass id to update). Admin/manager only; the editor becomes the rule owner. p_data keys: id, name, description, enabled, trigger_type, trigger_config, scope_type (org/client/list), scope_id, conditions[], condition_match (all/any), actions[], rate_limit_per_hour, template_key.

actions.name: automation_usage
actions.desc: Automation usage stats for the last p_days (1-90, default 30): rule counts, run totals by status, top rules and failing rules. Admin/manager only.

actions.name: automation_webhook_events_list
actions.desc: List recent inbound webhook events received through automation webhook keys (payload summary, resulting task, status), up to p_limit. Admin/manager only.

actions.name: automation_webhook_key_create
actions.desc: Create an inbound webhook key that turns incoming HTTP posts into tasks. Admin/manager only. p_data keys: name, list_id (target list). Returns the key/secret.

actions.name: automation_webhook_key_revoke
actions.desc: Revoke an inbound automation webhook key so it stops accepting events. Admin/manager only.

actions.name: automation_webhook_key_update
actions.desc: Rename an inbound webhook key or change its target list. Admin/manager only. p_data keys: name, list_id.

actions.name: automation_webhook_keys_list
actions.desc: List the org's inbound automation webhook keys (name, target list, created, last used, revoked). Admin/manager only.

actions.name: automations_list
actions.desc: List automation rules with run stats. Admin/manager only. p_filter keys: trigger_type, client_id, list_id, enabled (bool), search (text).

actions.name: billing_auto_get
actions.desc: Auto-billing / collections dashboard: engine settings (reminder ladder, WhatsApp campaigns, UPI id), per-client billing plans, waiting invoice drafts and upcoming sends. admin/manager/accounts_head (read).

actions.name: billing_auto_set
actions.desc: Update the org's auto-billing and payment-reminder engine settings. Admin/manager only. p_patch keys: enabled, wa_enabled, draft_lead_days, ladder (reminder day offsets), weekly_after, escalate_after, escalate_member_id, signoff, call_number, upi_id, wa_campaign_invoice, wa_campaign_reminder, wa_campaign_received.

actions.name: billing_client_set
actions.desc: Set one client's billing setup: WhatsApp number, reminders on/off, contact email and the monthly recurring plan. Admin/manager only. p_patch keys: billing_whatsapp, billing_reminders, contact_email, plan {is_active, amount, description, tax_kind, gst_rate, invoice_day, due_offset_days, due_day, starts_on, ends_on}.

actions.name: billing_draft_decide
actions.desc: Act on a waiting auto-billing invoice draft: p_action = 'approve' (goes out on its day), 'send' (issue the invoice now and notify the client), 'skip', or 'restore' (undo a skip). Admin/manager only.

actions.name: billing_draft_update
actions.desc: Edit a waiting auto-billing invoice draft before it is issued. Admin/manager only. p_patch keys: amount, description, tax_kind, gst_rate, period_label, send_on, due_offset_days, due_day, notes.

actions.name: billing_invoice_reminders
actions.desc: Turn automatic payment reminders off (p_on=false, e.g. owner chasing it personally) or back on for one invoice (p_invoice). Admin/manager only.

actions.name: exp_copy_month
actions.desc: Copy all company expenses from one month to another (p_from_year/p_from_month -> p_to_year/p_to_month), keeping day-of-month. Admin/manager only. Returns the new expense rows.

actions.name: exp_create
actions.desc: Record a company expense. Admin/manager only. p_data keys: expense_date, category, amount, vendor, notes.

actions.name: exp_delete
actions.desc: Soft-delete a company expense (sets deleted_at). Admin/manager only.

actions.name: exp_list
actions.desc: List company expenses between p_from and p_to dates (default all, up to p_limit). admin/manager/accounts_head (read).

actions.name: exp_update
actions.desc: Edit an existing company expense. Admin/manager only. p_data keys: expense_date, category, amount, vendor, notes.

actions.name: fixed_exp_delete
actions.desc: Delete a fixed (recurring monthly) expense definition; already-posted expense rows stay. Admin/manager only.

actions.name: fixed_exp_list
actions.desc: List fixed recurring monthly expenses (rent, salaries, subscriptions) with pay day and active window. admin/manager/accounts_head (read).

actions.name: fixed_exp_upsert
actions.desc: Create or update a fixed recurring monthly expense (pass id to update). Admin/manager only. p_data keys: id, name, category, amount, pay_day, starts_on, ends_on, is_active, notes.

actions.name: inv_aging_list
actions.desc: Receivables aging: every unpaid/partial invoice with client, balance due and days overdue bucket. admin/manager/accounts_head (read).

actions.name: inv_cancel
actions.desc: Cancel an invoice (status -> cancelled). Admin/manager only. Returns the invoice.

actions.name: inv_create
actions.desc: Create a new invoice or credit note. Admin/manager only. p_data keys: client_id, type (invoice/credit_note/bill), invoice_number, issued_on, due_date, period_start, period_end, period_label, line_items[], subtotal, discount_amount, taxable_value, gst_rate, cgst/sgst/igst_amount, tax_kind, place_of_supply, supply_type, hsn_sac, tds_rate, tds_amount, amount, currency, status, terms, notes, parent_invoice_id, no_reminders.

actions.name: inv_get
actions.desc: Get one invoice by id. admin/manager/accounts_head see any invoice in the org; a client login only its own brand's invoices.

actions.name: inv_get_next_bill_number
actions.desc: Reserve and return the next B-series bill number for the org (increments the counter). Admin/manager only.

actions.name: inv_get_next_credit_note_number
actions.desc: Reserve and return the next credit-note number for the org (increments the counter). Admin/manager only.

actions.name: inv_get_next_number
actions.desc: Reserve and return the next invoice number for the org (increments the counter). Admin/manager only.

actions.name: inv_hard_delete
actions.desc: Permanently purge an invoice (cannot be undone; prefer inv_soft_delete). Admin only.

actions.name: inv_list
actions.desc: List invoices, newest first; optional p_client_id filter, p_limit (default 500), p_include_deleted. admin/manager/accounts_head (read).

actions.name: inv_payment_delete
actions.desc: Delete (soft) a recorded payment on an invoice; the invoice's amount_paid and status re-sync automatically. Admin only.

actions.name: inv_payment_list
actions.desc: List payments recorded against one invoice (p_invoice_id). admin/manager/accounts_head, or a client login for its own invoice.

actions.name: inv_payment_record
actions.desc: Record a payment against an invoice; the invoice's amount_paid/status update automatically. Admin/manager only. p_data keys: invoice_id, amount, paid_on, method, reference, notes, razorpay_order_id, razorpay_payment_id, razorpay_signature.

actions.name: inv_payment_soft_delete
actions.desc: Tombstone a payment row; the parent invoice drops back to partial/due. Admin/manager only.

actions.name: inv_payments_list_range
actions.desc: Cash-basis revenue feed: all payments received between p_from and p_to with invoice and client (behind the P&L tab). admin/manager/accounts_head (read).

actions.name: inv_reassign_client
actions.desc: Link an invoice to a different client in this workspace (e.g. an invoice showing 'missing client'). p_snapshot (optional jsonb) replaces the printed billed-to details. Admin/manager only.

actions.name: inv_restore
actions.desc: Restore a soft-deleted invoice (clears deleted_at). Admin/manager only.

actions.name: inv_soft_delete
actions.desc: Soft-delete an invoice (moves it to trash; restorable with inv_restore). Admin/manager only.

actions.name: inv_update
actions.desc: Edit an existing invoice. Admin/manager only. p_data keys are the same as inv_create (client_id, line_items, amounts and taxes, dates, status, terms, notes, no_reminders, ...).

actions.name: org_attach_subscription
actions.desc: Attach the Razorpay subscription created by checkout to the caller's org (SaaS plan billing); only the org's pending subscription id is accepted. Admin only.

actions.name: org_billing_get
actions.desc: The org's SaaS plan and billing state: plan, status/trial, payment state, plan limits vs current client and seat counts, billing exemption. Any staff session.

actions.name: plan_catalog
actions.desc: SaaS plan catalog with limits (max clients, max seats, features) used for plan-limit checks. No session needed.

actions.name: plans_get
actions.desc: Public list of active SaaS plans (label, price, limits, features) for signup and the paywall. No session needed.

actions.name: plans_list_admin
actions.desc: List all SaaS plans including inactive ones, for editing. Platform owner only.

actions.name: plans_upsert
actions.desc: Create or edit a SaaS plan (p_key = plan key). Platform owner only. p_patch keys: label, price_paise, currency, max_clients, max_seats, features, razorpay_plan_id, sort_order, active.

actions.name: recurring_delete
actions.desc: Delete a recurring invoice template (stops future auto-generated invoices for that client). Admin/manager only (_require_billing_role).

actions.name: recurring_list
actions.desc: List recurring invoice templates, optionally for one client (p_client_id). admin/manager/accounts_head (read).

actions.name: recurring_upsert
actions.desc: Create or update a recurring invoice template that auto-generates monthly invoices. Admin/manager only. p_data keys: id, client_id, is_active, invoice_day, due_offset_days, gst_rate, hsn_sac, line_items[], terms, notes, starts_on, ends_on.

actions.name: time_billable_summary
actions.desc: Uninvoiced billable time for one client between p_from and p_to as invoice-ready lines (hours x rate = amount). p_group: 'task' | 'task_member' | 'member' | 'total'; p_only_approved limits to approved timesheets. admin/manager/accounts_head (read).

actions.name: time_invoice_entries
actions.desc: List the time entries linked to an invoice (p_invoice_id). admin/manager/accounts_head (read).

actions.name: time_mark_invoiced
actions.desc: Link billable time entries (p_entry_ids) to an invoice (all-or-nothing; refuses entries already on another invoice). Admin/manager only.

actions.name: time_rate_delete
actions.desc: Delete an hourly billing rate. Admin/manager only.

actions.name: time_rate_upsert
actions.desc: Create or update an hourly billing rate. Admin/manager only. p_data keys: id, client_id (null = all clients), member_id (null = everyone), hourly_rate, currency.

actions.name: time_rates_list
actions.desc: List hourly billing rates (per client / per member / default). admin/manager/accounts_head (read).

actions.name: time_unmark_invoiced
actions.desc: Unlink time entries from an invoice (all of them when p_entry_ids is null) so they become billable again. Admin/manager only.

actions.name: gcal_events_list
actions.desc: The caller's synced Google Calendar events between p_from and p_to (max 62 days; default one week): title, time, location, calendar, color. Empty if Google is not connected. Any staff.

actions.name: gcal_settings_set
actions.desc: Update the caller's Google Calendar sync settings. Any staff with a connected Google account. p_patch keys: push_enabled, push_done, push_types[] (task, post, direct, milestone, seo_report, ad, meeting, request, lead), selected_calendar_ids[].

actions.name: gcal_status
actions.desc: The caller's Google Calendar connection status: connected account, calendars, selected calendars, push settings, last sync. Any staff.

actions.name: msg_add_members
actions.desc: Add staff members (p_member_ids) to a chat group or channel. Groups: creator only; public channels: any member or manager; private channels: manager. Staff only.

actions.name: msg_channel_update
actions.desc: Change a chat channel's settings. Channel managers only. p_patch keys: title, description, is_private, archived.

actions.name: msg_channels_browse
actions.desc: Browse chat channels: public channels plus private ones the caller belongs to (archived flagged), optional search p_q. Staff only.

actions.name: msg_client_channel
actions.desc: Find or create the internal chat channel for a client (p_client_id) and return its id, e.g. for 'Open channel' from a client page. Staff only.

actions.name: msg_conversation_get
actions.desc: Get one chat conversation (DM, group or channel) with members and settings, e.g. to preview a public channel. Staff who can read it.

actions.name: msg_conversations_list
actions.desc: The caller's chat sidebar: DMs, groups and joined channels with unread counts, last message and mute state (archived channels hidden). Staff only.

actions.name: msg_create_channel
actions.desc: Create a chat channel (p_title, p_description, p_is_private, initial p_member_ids). Staff only.

actions.name: msg_create_group
actions.desc: Create a group chat with the caller plus p_member_ids (same-org staff). Staff only.

actions.name: msg_delete
actions.desc: Delete a chat message: your own, or any message in a channel if you are admin/manager (moderation). Staff only.

actions.name: msg_edit
actions.desc: Edit the text (p_body, optional p_title) of your own chat message. Staff only.

actions.name: msg_join
actions.desc: Join a public, non-archived chat channel. Staff only.

actions.name: msg_leave
actions.desc: Leave a chat group or channel (not #general; a group's creator cannot leave). Staff only.

actions.name: msg_link_task
actions.desc: Link a task to a chat message (or unlink with p_task_id null). Caller must be in the conversation and able to see the task.

actions.name: msg_mark_read
actions.desc: Mark a chat conversation as read for the caller. Staff only.

actions.name: msg_pin
actions.desc: Pin or unpin (p_on) a chat message in its conversation. Conversation managers.

actions.name: msg_pins
actions.desc: List pinned messages of a chat conversation. Staff who can read it.

actions.name: msg_react
actions.desc: Toggle an emoji reaction (p_emoji) on a chat message. Conversation members.

actions.name: msg_remove_member
actions.desc: Remove a member from a chat group (creator only) or channel (managers; never from #general).

actions.name: msg_rename
actions.desc: Rename a chat group (creator) or channel (managers; slug follows).

actions.name: msg_replies
actions.desc: Thread view: a root chat message and all its replies. Staff who can read the conversation.

actions.name: msg_search
actions.desc: Full-text search chat messages the caller can read, optionally within one conversation (p_conversation_id), up to p_limit. Staff only.

actions.name: msg_send
actions.desc: Send a chat message to a conversation (DM/group/channel), optionally as a thread reply (p_parent_id), with p_mentions (member ids) and p_attachments; notifies other members (bell + push) per their preferences. Staff only.

actions.name: msg_set_mute
actions.desc: Mute or unmute (p_muted) a chat conversation for the caller. Staff only.

actions.name: msg_start_dm
actions.desc: Find or create a 1:1 direct-message conversation with another staff member (p_other_member_id). Staff only.

actions.name: msg_task_create
actions.desc: Create a task from a chat message and link it to the message. Staff only. p_data keys as task_create: title, description, client_id, list_id, due_at, priority, assignee_ids, status, ...

actions.name: msg_thread
actions.desc: Main message feed of a conversation (top-level messages only), paged backwards with p_before and p_limit (default 50). Staff who can read it.

actions.name: presence_list
actions.desc: Who is online: every staff member's online flag (active in last 2 min), last_active_at, status text/emoji and do-not-disturb. Any staff.

actions.name: presence_ping
actions.desc: Heartbeat that marks the caller as active (p_visible = tab visible). Any staff.

actions.name: client_create
actions.desc: Create a new client (brand) row. Admin/manager only; enforces the org plan's client limit (error plan.limit_clients). p_data is any clients columns, e.g. name, industry, contact_name, email, phone, gst_number, drive_folder_url, status; unknown keys are ignored. Returns the inserted client.

actions.name: client_member_make_primary
actions.desc: Make one client-portal login (a brand's team_members row with role client) the brand's primary contact, demoting the previous primary. Admin/manager only, own workspace.

actions.name: client_member_remove
actions.desc: Soft-delete one client-portal login of a brand. Refuses to remove the last remaining member; if the primary is removed, the oldest remaining member becomes primary. Admin/manager only, own workspace. Returns true.

actions.name: client_update
actions.desc: Update a client's (brand's) fields. Admin/manager only, same org. p_patch: any clients columns (e.g. name, status, contact details, brand brief, package/scope fields, drive_folder_url); protected/unknown keys are skipped. Returns {ok, client, skipped[]}.

actions.name: list_credentials
actions.desc: List the stored credentials (vault field keys/labels, no plaintext) captured in a client's onboarding submission. Admin/manager only.

actions.name: read_credential
actions.desc: Decrypt and return ONE stored client credential (e.g. a social or website login) by p_field_key; the reveal is audit-logged. Admin/manager only. Sensitive: only call when the user explicitly asks to see that credential.

actions.name: content_delete
actions.desc: Soft-delete a post (content row) by id. Content staff only (admin/manager/editor/designer).

actions.name: content_insert
actions.desc: Create one or more posts in a client's content calendar. Content staff only (admin/manager/editor/designer). p_rows is a JSON array of content rows: client_id, title, type (reel|creative|carousel|extra), post_date, caption, hashtags, concept, workflow_status, assigned_to, etc. Returns inserted rows.

actions.name: content_schedule
actions.desc: Schedule a post for publishing to ONE connected social account (single-destination legacy form). Content staff only. The post must be client-approved. Args: p_id post, p_when time (null = now), p_social_account_id. Leave p_media_url empty: the post's own Drive link is downloaded when it publishes (Drive links in p_media_url are ignored). Will post to the client's real Instagram/Facebook.

actions.name: content_schedule_multi
actions.desc: Schedule a post to publish to several connected social accounts (p_account_ids, from social_accounts_list) at p_when (IST timestamp). The post must be client-approved. Leave p_media_url empty: the post's own Drive link is downloaded when it publishes (Drive links in p_media_url are ignored). Content staff only. De-selected destinations' pending jobs are cancelled; jobs already publishing are left and reported in in_flight. Posts to the client's real Instagram/Facebook.

actions.name: content_unschedule
actions.desc: Cancel a post's pending publish jobs (unschedule it). Content staff only. Jobs already mid-publish cannot be stopped and are returned as in_flight.

actions.name: content_update
actions.desc: Update a post (content row) by id: caption, hashtags, concept, post_date, workflow_status (briefed|in_production|in_review|sent_to_client|revision|approved|scheduled|posted|missed), assigned_to, production_done, preview urls, etc. Content staff only; changing client_approval is admin/manager only (approval may trigger auto-publish). Returns the updated row.

actions.name: content_version_snapshot
actions.desc: Record a revision snapshot of a post when a new revision round is sent to the client. Content staff only. p_data keys: post_id, revision_round, caption, hashtags, concept, preview_urls, video_url, video_thumbnail_url, client_remarks, triggered_by.

actions.name: publish_job_mark_deleted
actions.desc: Mark a published social post job as deleted (after it was removed on Instagram/Facebook) and put the post back to approved so it can be re-published. Admin/manager only.

actions.name: publish_job_retry
actions.desc: Retry a failed social publish job: puts it back in the publish queue and marks the post scheduled. Admin/manager only. Will post to the client's real social account.

actions.name: publish_jobs_list
actions.desc: List recent social publish jobs (status, platform, scheduled time, errors) for status badges, optionally for one client. Admin/manager/editor/designer.

actions.name: publish_jobs_overview
actions.desc: Cross-brand publish-queue overview: upcoming pending jobs within p_days (incl. overdue), recent failures and recent successes. Admin/manager/editor/designer.

actions.name: sevak_calendar_load
actions.desc: Load a whole content calendar for one client in a single call: one post (content row + task) per item, maker held as planned assignee until the production day, optional production subtasks, scope month and shoots linked. Idempotent per (client, post_date, title). Admin/manager/editor/designer. p_posts[]: post_date, type (reel|creative|carousel|extra), title, concept, caption, hashtags, posting_time, reference_links, designer_notes, editor_notes, maker, production_date, subtasks[{who,title,due}]. p_options: quiet_subtasks, link_scope, lead_days.

actions.name: sevak_posts
actions.desc: Posts by POSTING date (not the task's production-day due date) for one client (p_client_id) or all, between p_from and p_to (default today; max 92 days). Each post: id, task_id, client, title, type, posting_time, status, client_approval, maker, handed_over, production_day. Admin/manager see all; others only posts whose task they can see.

actions.name: social_account_disconnect
actions.desc: Disconnect (soft-revoke) one connected Instagram/Facebook account: drops its token, marks it revoked and cancels its pending publish jobs; history is kept. Admin/manager only.

actions.name: social_account_disconnect_all
actions.desc: Disconnect every connected social account of one client (p_client_id), cancelling their pending publish jobs. Admin/manager only.

actions.name: social_account_set_primary
actions.desc: Mark one connected social account as the primary account for its brand (clears the flag on siblings). Admin/manager only.

actions.name: social_accounts_list
actions.desc: List connected Instagram/Facebook accounts for the org, optionally one client (p_client_id): platform, username, status, primary flag, token expiry; never returns tokens. Admin/manager only.

actions.name: social_insights_summary
actions.desc: Social media insights for a client: followers/reach series, latest snapshot (impressions, profile views, website clicks), per-platform breakdown and top posts. Window: p_month (calendar month) or trailing p_days; p_platform optional. Admin/manager/seo.

actions.name: social_oauth_begin
actions.desc: Start connecting a client's social account: mints an OAuth state for (client, platform 'instagram'|'facebook') used by the Meta OAuth redirect. Admin/manager only.

actions.name: social_oauth_candidates
actions.desc: Get the pending list of social accounts/pages returned by the latest OAuth connect, for the picker (no tokens). Admin/manager only.

actions.name: social_oauth_pick
actions.desc: Finish a social OAuth connect by choosing which candidate accounts to connect. p_selected: array of 'platform:platform_account_id' keys. Admin/manager only.

actions.name: doc_bulk
actions.desc: Bulk action on docs: p_ids[] with p_action duplicate|delete|archive|unarchive|undelete. Applies each per the caller's doc access. Returns {ok, done, failed[]}.

actions.name: doc_client_get
actions.desc: Open (find-or-create) a client's SOP doc (p_kind 'sop') or the org-wide playbook (p_kind 'playbook'). Any staff with access. Returns the full doc.

actions.name: doc_create
actions.desc: Create a doc/wiki page. Any staff. p_data keys: title, parent_id, client_id, kind (doc|meeting), icon, blocks, meta, tags, sharing (private|people|workspace), is_wiki, is_template (admin/manager). Returns the doc.

actions.name: doc_delete
actions.desc: Move a doc (and its subpages) to trash. Requires manage access on the doc.

actions.name: doc_duplicate
actions.desc: Duplicate a doc, optionally with its subpages (p_with_children, default true). Returns the copy.

actions.name: doc_get
actions.desc: Get a full doc (title, blocks, meta, sharing, breadcrumbs) by id if the caller has access; also records a view.

actions.name: doc_list
actions.desc: List docs. p_filter keys: tab (all|my|shared|private|meeting|wikis|favorites|recent|archived|templates|trash), client_id, agency_only, parent_id ('root' or uuid), search, tag, kind, order (updated|position|title|views), limit. Returns lightweight doc rows.

actions.name: doc_move
actions.desc: Move a doc under another parent (p_parent_id, null = root) and/or reorder it (p_position). Needs edit access.

actions.name: doc_ping
actions.desc: Presence heartbeat for an open doc: marks the caller as viewing/editing and returns the current version plus who else is in it. Bookkeeping only.

actions.name: doc_public_link
actions.desc: Turn a doc's public share link on or off (p_on). Requires manage access. Returns {public_token}.

actions.name: doc_save
actions.desc: Save doc content with optimistic locking: p_base_version plus p_patch keys title, blocks, meta. Returns {ok, version} or {ok:false, conflict:true, doc} if someone else saved first.

actions.name: doc_search
actions.desc: Full-text search across docs the caller can access (p_q, p_limit). Returns id, title, icon, kind, client_name, parent_title, snippet.

actions.name: doc_set
actions.desc: Change doc properties without a version bump. p_patch keys: is_wiki, tags, icon, client_id, archived.

actions.name: doc_share_set
actions.desc: Set a doc's sharing mode (p_sharing private|people|workspace) and per-person access (p_shares: [{member_id, access}]). Requires manage access.

actions.name: doc_undelete
actions.desc: Restore a doc from trash (creator or admin/manager). If its parent is still trashed it surfaces at the root.

actions.name: doc_version_get
actions.desc: Get one saved historical version of a doc (by version id).

actions.name: doc_version_restore
actions.desc: Restore a doc to a saved version (current content is snapshotted first, so it is reversible). Needs edit access.

actions.name: doc_versions_list
actions.desc: List saved versions of a doc (who/when) for version history.

actions.name: form_delete
actions.desc: Delete a form. Form owner/creator or admin/manager.

actions.name: form_duplicate
actions.desc: Duplicate a form (new slug). Any staff except freelancers.

actions.name: form_get
actions.desc: Get one form definition (fields, settings, routing, public slug). Any staff except freelancers.

actions.name: form_submission_create_task
actions.desc: Create a task from an existing form submission (if not already created). Form owner/creator or admin/manager.

actions.name: form_submission_delete
actions.desc: Delete a form submission. Form owner/creator or admin/manager.

actions.name: form_submissions_list
actions.desc: List submissions of a form. p_filter keys: status, search, limit, offset. Form owner/creator or admin/manager.

actions.name: form_upsert
actions.desc: Create or update a form. p_data keys: id (omit to create), name, description, slug, audience, is_open, template_key, fields[], settings, notify_ids[], defaults, assignee_ids[], tag_ids[], priority, due_days, confirmation, redirect_url, list_id, client_id, owner_id. Owner or admin/manager for edits.

actions.name: forms_list
actions.desc: List the org's forms with submission counts. Any staff except freelancers.

actions.name: lead_convert
actions.desc: Mark a lead (a task of type lead) as won/converted, optionally linking the client it became (p_client_id). Admin/manager only. Returns the task row.

actions.name: lead_create
actions.desc: Create a sales lead (tracked as a task in the leads pipeline). Admin/manager only. p_data keys: name, email, company, phone, status, value, next_follow_up, source, notes, assignee_ids[].

actions.name: leads_bootstrap
actions.desc: Load leads-pipeline setup: whether the lead type is enabled, the pipeline list/statuses, and (platform org) unlinked website leads. Admin/manager only.

actions.name: leads_list
actions.desc: List website prospect leads (platform-owner org only; tenant orgs get nothing), optionally by p_status. Admin/manager only.

actions.name: leads_resync
actions.desc: Re-sync all website leads into lead tasks (platform org only). Admin/manager. Bulk.

actions.name: leads_set_status
actions.desc: Set the status of a website prospect lead by id (platform org only). Admin/manager only.

actions.name: inbox_counts
actions.desc: Unread counts for the caller's notification inbox tabs: {primary, other, later}. Any staff.

actions.name: inbox_list
actions.desc: List the caller's notification inbox (last 60 days) for one tab: p_tab primary|other|later|cleared. Returns notifications with read flag, inbox_state, snooze_until. Any staff.

actions.name: inbox_set
actions.desc: Move the caller's notifications (p_ids[]) to an inbox state: p_state primary|later|cleared; 'later' takes p_snooze_until. Clearing also marks them read. Any staff.

actions.name: member_prefs_get
actions.desc: Get the caller's personal UI preferences (week_start, date/time format, accessibility, sidebar pins, etc.).

actions.name: member_prefs_set
actions.desc: Merge-update the caller's personal UI preferences. p_patch keys: high_contrast, reduce_motion, send_on_enter, link_previews (booleans), week_start (0|1|6), date_format, time_format (12h|24h), rail_pins[], rail_hidden[]; null removes a key.

actions.name: notif_insert
actions.desc: Create a notification. Staff (admin/manager/seo/editor/designer). p_recipient uses the recipient grammar (member name, 'role:admin,manager', 'all', a brand name for the client portal); plus title, message, type, client_name, post_title, link_type, link_id. May trigger push.

actions.name: notif_list
actions.desc: The caller's own notification feed with a per-caller read flag. p_limit (default 50), p_unread_only (default true). Any staff.

actions.name: notif_mark_all_read
actions.desc: Mark all of the caller's notifications as read (per-caller receipts).

actions.name: notif_mark_read
actions.desc: Mark specific notifications (p_ids[]) as read for the caller.

actions.name: notif_prefs_get
actions.desc: Get the caller's notification preferences: per-event channel switches and smart_push.

actions.name: notif_prefs_set
actions.desc: Update the caller's notification preferences. p_prefs keys: events {assigned|mentioned|comment|status|due_soon|overdue|reminder|approval|message|completed: {inbox, push, whatsapp, email: boolean}}, smart_push (boolean).

actions.name: wa_my_settings_get
actions.desc: Get the caller's own WhatsApp notification settings: phone, opted_in, quiet hours, plus whether the org has WhatsApp enabled.

actions.name: wa_my_settings_set
actions.desc: Update the caller's own WhatsApp notification settings. p_data keys: phone, opted_in, quiet_start, quiet_end.

actions.name: wa_outbox_list
actions.desc: List recent outgoing WhatsApp messages (status, recipient, template, errors) for the org. Admin/manager only.

actions.name: wa_send_welcome
actions.desc: Send the one-time WhatsApp welcome note (login link; accounts role gets the GST/invoices version). No p_member_ids = everyone on the team with a number not welcomed yet (never the caller); p_member_ids = exactly those people, even if welcomed before. Admin/manager only. Sends real messages.

actions.name: wa_team_list
actions.desc: List staff with their WhatsApp numbers, opt-in/quiet-hour settings and when they were last sent the welcome note (welcomed_at). Admin/manager only.

actions.name: wa_team_set
actions.desc: Set a staff member's WhatsApp settings (p_member_id). p_data keys: phone, opted_in, quiet_start, quiet_end. Admin/manager only.

actions.name: wa_test_send
actions.desc: Send a test WhatsApp message to the caller or (admin/manager) another member p_member_id. Sends a real message.

actions.name: create_onboarding_submission
actions.desc: Start client onboarding: creates an onboarding submission (the client's onboarding form/contract wizard) for p_client_id with form template, contract template, scope package, team lead, start date, Drive folder, template overrides, placeholders and optional welcome-kit template. Admin/manager only. Returns the submission.

actions.name: get_onboarding_submission
actions.desc: Get a client's onboarding submission by id (answers, status, contract and signing state). Admin/manager only.

actions.name: ad_account_unlink
actions.desc: Unlink a Meta ad account from a brand so the Ads tab stops syncing it (campaigns already synced stay). Admin/manager only.

actions.name: ad_accounts_list
actions.desc: List the Meta ad accounts linked to brands (optionally one client): name, status, when the connection expires, last sync time and last error. Linked from Settings > Connected accounts; they fill the Ads tab automatically. Admin/manager only.

actions.name: dash_behind
actions.desc: Dashboard card 'Who is behind': per person overdue (last 30 days), older overdue, due in 3 days, on-time %. p_filter keys: client_ids[], list_ids[], assignee_ids[], team_ids[], types[], tag_ids[], priorities[], agency_only, top_level, range, date_from, date_to. Only tasks the caller may see.

actions.name: dash_by_assignee
actions.desc: Dashboard card: tasks by assignee (open, in progress, done in window, overdue, estimate, tracked time). p_filter: client_ids[], list_ids[], assignee_ids[], team_ids[], types[], tag_ids[], priorities[], agency_only, top_level, range, date_from, date_to. Only tasks the caller may see.

actions.name: dash_calculation
actions.desc: Dashboard calculation card over filtered tasks. p_config: {field: 'estimate'|'time'|<custom field uuid>, op: sum|avg|min|max|count, scope}. p_filter: client_ids[], list_ids[], assignee_ids[], team_ids[], types[], tag_ids[], priorities[], agency_only, top_level.

actions.name: dash_completed
actions.desc: Completed-tasks report for a date window: total, on_time, late, no_due, per-bucket series, by_assignee, by_client. p_filter: range, date_from, date_to, bucket plus client_ids[], list_ids[], assignee_ids[], team_ids[], types[], tag_ids[], priorities[].

actions.name: dash_custom_chart
actions.desc: Custom dashboard chart over tasks. p_config: group_by (status|priority|assignee|client|list|type|tag|created_week|completed_week|due_month|field:<uuid>), metric (count|estimate|time), scope (open|closed|all), range_on. p_filter as other dash_* cards. Returns {rows:[{key,label,value}]}.

actions.name: dash_cycle_lead
actions.desc: Cycle time (first active status to done) and lead time (created to done) for tasks completed in the window, with a trend per bucket. p_filter: range, date_from, date_to, bucket plus the usual task filters.

actions.name: dash_portfolio
actions.desc: Portfolio progress card: task progress per client or per list. p_config: {group: client|list}. p_filter: the usual dash_* task filters.

actions.name: dash_priority_over_time
actions.desc: Line chart: open tasks per priority at the end of each time bucket. p_filter: range, date_from, date_to, bucket plus the usual task filters.

actions.name: dash_status_over_time
actions.desc: Line chart: to-do / in-progress / completed task counts at the end of each time bucket. p_filter: range, date_from, date_to, bucket plus the usual task filters.

actions.name: dash_time_in_status
actions.desc: Dashboard card: average/median time tasks spend in each status, overall and per client, over a date range (needs task status history). Any staff; limited to tasks the caller can see. p_filter keys: range, date_from, date_to, client_ids[], assignee_ids[], list_ids[], team_ids[], tag_ids[], priorities[], types[], agency_only, top_level. Returns {available, statuses[], clients[]}.

actions.name: dash_unassigned
actions.desc: Dashboard card: open tasks with no assignee - count, overdue, due this week, top clients and a sample of 6 task rows. Any staff; visibility-filtered. p_filter keys: range, date_from, date_to, client_ids[], assignee_ids[], list_ids[], team_ids[], tag_ids[], priorities[], types[], agency_only, top_level.

actions.name: dashboard_delete
actions.desc: Soft-delete a custom dashboard and drop it from favorites. Owner, or admin/manager for non-private dashboards.

actions.name: dashboard_duplicate
actions.desc: Copy a custom dashboard (cards, filters) into a new dashboard owned by the caller. Any staff who can view the source dashboard.

actions.name: dashboard_get
actions.desc: Get one custom dashboard with its cards, filters and sharing settings. Any staff who can view it (private ones only by owner).

actions.name: dashboard_list
actions.desc: List the custom dashboards the caller can view (own, shared to their role/member id, or org-wide), newest first. Any staff.

actions.name: dashboard_upsert
actions.desc: Create or update a custom dashboard (id present = update; owner or admin/manager for non-private). p_data keys: id?, name, description, icon, color, visibility (private/shared/org), shared_roles[], shared_member_ids[], cards[], filters, refresh_seconds, template, client_id.

actions.name: favorite_toggle
actions.desc: Add or remove a sidebar favorite for the caller. p_kind (task, list, doc, dashboard, client, url...), p_ref_id, p_label, p_url (required http(s) for kind url). Returns {on}. Any staff.

actions.name: global_search
actions.desc: Search across tasks (title or custom id like PREFIX-123 / #123), clients, team members and task lists by text. Any staff; tasks are visibility-filtered. Returns {tasks, clients, members, lists}, up to p_limit (max 25) each.

actions.name: goal_delete
actions.desc: Delete a goal (and its targets) and remove it from favorites. Goal owner/creator or admin/manager.

actions.name: goal_folder_delete
actions.desc: Delete a goal folder; its goals are kept and moved out of the folder. Folder owner or admin/manager.

actions.name: goal_folder_upsert
actions.desc: Create or rename/recolor a goal folder (id present = update; owner or admin/manager). p_data keys: id?, name, color, is_private, position.

actions.name: goal_get
actions.desc: Get one goal with its targets, progress and update history. Any staff who can see the goal (private goals only owners/creator).

actions.name: goal_target_delete
actions.desc: Delete one target (key result) from a goal; goal progress is recomputed. Goal owner/creator or admin/manager.

actions.name: goal_target_log
actions.desc: Log a manual progress update on a goal target (number, currency or true/false) with an optional note; keeps history. Goal owner/creator or admin/manager.

actions.name: goal_target_upsert
actions.desc: Create or edit a goal target (key result). p_data keys: id?, goal_id, name, kind (number|currency|boolean|tasks), unit, currency, start_value, target_value, current_value (create only), task_filter (for task-count targets), owner_id, position. Goal owner/creator or admin/manager.

actions.name: goal_upsert
actions.desc: Create or update a goal (id present = update; owner/creator or admin/manager). p_data keys: id?, folder_id, name, description, color, owner_ids[], client_id, start_date, due_date, is_private, archived, position.

actions.name: goals_overview
actions.desc: List all goals the caller can see (with progress) plus goal folders with goal counts and average progress. Any staff. p_include_archived adds archived goals.

actions.name: goals_progress
actions.desc: Goal progress card data: progress for the given goal ids (or the caller's visible goals when p_ids is null), up to p_limit. Any staff.

actions.name: home_summary
actions.desc: Home page summary for the caller: counts of my open / overdue / due-today tasks, delegated open tasks, and this week's workload. Any staff; admin/manager see org-wide numbers, others only tasks they can see.

actions.name: whiteboard_create
actions.desc: Create a whiteboard. Any staff. p_data keys: title, client_id, scene ({v, elements[]}), is_private, thumb. Returns the board.

actions.name: whiteboard_delete
actions.desc: Soft-delete a whiteboard and remove it from favorites. Creator or admin/manager.

actions.name: whiteboard_duplicate
actions.desc: Copy a whiteboard (scene and links) into a new board owned by the caller. Any staff who can view it.

actions.name: whiteboard_get
actions.desc: Get a whiteboard with its full scene (elements), version and metadata. Any staff who can view it (private boards only by creator).

actions.name: whiteboard_head
actions.desc: Lightweight check of a whiteboard's current version, title and last editor (for polling/conflict detection). Any staff who can view it.

actions.name: whiteboard_list
actions.desc: List whiteboards the caller can see. p_filter keys: client_id, agency_only, mine, favorites, archived, search, limit (max 500). Any staff.

actions.name: whiteboard_save
actions.desc: Save a whiteboard scene with optimistic concurrency: p_base_version must match the stored version, otherwise returns {ok:false, conflict:true} with the latest scene. p_checkpoint forces a version snapshot. Editors of the board only.

actions.name: whiteboard_task_cards
actions.desc: Fetch live task rows for task cards placed on a whiteboard, by task ids; tasks the caller cannot see are omitted. Any staff.

actions.name: whiteboard_update
actions.desc: Update whiteboard metadata. p_patch keys: title, client_id, is_private, archived. Board editors only (creator, admin/manager, or staff for non-private boards).

actions.name: whiteboard_version_get
actions.desc: Get one saved snapshot (version) of a whiteboard, including its scene. Any staff who can view the board.

actions.name: whiteboard_version_restore
actions.desc: Restore a whiteboard to a saved version snapshot (current scene is snapshotted first). Board editors only.

actions.name: whiteboard_versions
actions.desc: List saved version snapshots of a whiteboard (who saved, when, element count). Any staff who can view the board.

actions.name: whiteboards_for_task
actions.desc: List whiteboards that contain a card/sticky linked to the given task. Any staff; private boards only for their creator.

actions.name: client_update_self
actions.desc: Client portal: the logged-in client edits their own brand contact details. p_patch keys (whitelist): contact_name, contact_email, contact_phone, instagram_handle. Client role only; notifies admin/manager.

actions.name: content_client_review
actions.desc: Client portal: the client approves a post or requests a revision. p_client_approval: approved|revision|pending; p_workflow_status: sent_to_client|revision|approved|scheduled|posted; p_remarks = feedback. Client role only, own brand's posts.

actions.name: insights_summary_for_self
actions.desc: Client portal: the client's own social insights for a month (default last 30 days) - per-platform metrics, series and top posts. Client role only.

actions.name: inv_list_for_self
actions.desc: Client portal: list the logged-in client's own invoices, newest first (max 200). Client role only.

actions.name: notif_insert_for_self
actions.desc: Client portal: the client sends a notification to agency staff (a 'role:...' target or a staff member's name). Client identity is stamped from the session. Args: p_recipient, p_title, p_message, p_type, p_post_title, p_link_type, p_link_id. Client role only.

actions.name: notif_list_for_self
actions.desc: Client portal: list notifications addressed to the client's brand (plus 'all' broadcasts) with read state. Client role only.

actions.name: notif_mark_read_for_self
actions.desc: Client portal: mark the given notification ids as read for the client. Client role only.

actions.name: portal_get_onboarding_submission
actions.desc: Client portal: fetch the logged-in client's onboarding form submission (form data, status). Client role only.

actions.name: reports_list_for_self
actions.desc: Client portal: list the client's own monthly social reports (month, headline KPIs like reach/impressions/new followers, PDF link, when emailed). Client role only.

actions.name: save_onboarding_step
actions.desc: Client portal onboarding wizard: auto-save one step; p_form_patch keys are merged into the submission's form data. Client session tied to that submission only.

actions.name: submit_onboarding
actions.desc: Client portal onboarding wizard: final submit - merges form data, encrypts and stores credentials, records consent, fills mapped client fields and notifies the team. Client session tied to that submission only.

actions.name: report_period_data
actions.desc: For a client and a date range (p_start, p_end, inclusive): posts planned vs posted by type, shoots done (tasks starting with Shoot), ad spend logged in the Ads tab, and Instagram followers at the start and end from the daily count; each with the same-length period before it. Feeds the Reports builder. Admin/manager only.

actions.name: report_update
actions.desc: Edit a saved monthly social report (any column except id, org_id, client_id, timestamps, deleted_at, last_emailed_at), e.g. KPIs, agency_notes. Admin/manager only.

actions.name: activity_log_list
actions.desc: Read the org's audit/activity log, newest first. Filters: p_action, p_table, p_actor (name contains), p_since, p_limit (max 2000). Admin/manager only.

actions.name: api_key_create
actions.desc: Create a personal API key for the public API; the raw key is returned only once. Args: p_name, p_scopes (e.g. tasks:read, tasks:write), p_expires_days. Staff with the use_api permission (not clients).

actions.name: api_key_revoke
actions.desc: Revoke an API key. Its owner, or an admin for anyone's key.

actions.name: api_keys_list
actions.desc: List API keys (prefix, scopes, expiry, last used) - own keys, or all org keys for admin; also the available scopes. Staff with the use_api permission.

actions.name: mfa_admin_reset
actions.desc: Remove another member's two-factor authentication (e.g. lost phone); they re-enrol on next login if policy requires. Admin only.

actions.name: mfa_disable
actions.desc: Turn off the caller's own 2FA after verifying a current TOTP or recovery code (p_code); refused when 2FA is required for their role. Any staff.

actions.name: mfa_enroll_confirm
actions.desc: Finish enrolling the caller's 2FA by verifying a TOTP code from their authenticator app; returns one-time recovery codes. Any staff.

actions.name: mfa_enroll_start
actions.desc: Start 2FA enrolment for the caller: generates a TOTP secret and otpauth URI/QR for an authenticator app. Any staff.

actions.name: mfa_recovery_regenerate
actions.desc: Regenerate the caller's 2FA recovery codes after verifying a current code (p_code). Any staff.

actions.name: mfa_status
actions.desc: The caller's 2FA status: enabled, enrolled date, recovery codes left, and whether policy requires 2FA for their role. Any staff.

actions.name: my_permissions
actions.desc: The caller's effective permissions (permission key -> boolean from their preset or custom role) plus role info and whether 2FA is required. Any staff.

actions.name: revoke_all_sessions
actions.desc: Log a user out everywhere by revoking all their active sessions (offboarding / suspected compromise); the caller's own session survives unless they target themselves. Returns count. Admin only.

actions.name: role_assign
actions.desc: Assign a member a custom role (p_role_id) or a preset base role (p_role_id null + p_base_role: manager, accounts_head, seo, editor, designer, freelancer); their role_level becomes the role's base. Admin only.

actions.name: role_delete
actions.desc: Delete a custom role; members holding it fall back to their base role's preset permissions. Admin only.

actions.name: role_upsert
actions.desc: Create or update a custom role. p_data keys: id?, name, description, base_role (manager|accounts_head|seo|editor|designer|freelancer), permissions {key: boolean}. Admin only.

actions.name: roles_list
actions.desc: List preset and custom roles with their permission sets, labels and member counts, plus the list of permission keys. Any staff.

actions.name: security_settings_get
actions.desc: Org security policy: idle session timeout minutes and which roles must use 2FA. Any staff.

actions.name: security_settings_set
actions.desc: Update org security policy. p_patch keys: idle_minutes (0 or 5-1440), mfa_required_roles[] (staff role names). Admin only.

actions.name: client_update_seo
actions.desc: Update a client's SEO settings. p_patch keys (whitelist): seo_sheet_url, seo_monthly_target, seo_config, seo_report_cadence. Admin/manager/seo only.

actions.name: admin_hard_delete
actions.desc: Permanently delete a soft-deleted row from a whitelisted table (clients, content, team_members, monthly_reports, seo_reports, daily_notes, notifications, ads, ad_spend_entries, attendance, direct_tasks, invoices) by id. Admin only. Irreversible.

actions.name: admin_restore
actions.desc: Restore (un-delete) a soft-deleted row in a whitelisted table (clients, content, team_members, monthly_reports, seo_reports, daily_notes, notifications, ads, ad_spend_entries, attendance, direct_tasks, invoices) by id. Admin only.

actions.name: admin_soft_delete
actions.desc: Soft-delete (move to trash) a row in a whitelisted table (clients, content, team_members, monthly_reports, seo_reports, daily_notes, notifications, ads, ad_spend_entries, attendance, direct_tasks, invoices) by id. Admin/manager only.

actions.name: agency_get_auto_publish
actions.desc: Get the org's auto-publish setting (whether approved posts publish automatically to Instagram/Facebook, and at what hour). Admin/manager only.

actions.name: agency_set_auto_publish
actions.desc: Turn auto-publish-on-approval on/off for the whole org (p_on) and optionally set the publish hour (p_hour, 0-23 IST). Admin only. When on, client-approved posts get published to the brand's real social accounts.

actions.name: agency_settings_get
actions.desc: Get the org's agency settings (legal/trade name, branding, address, GSTIN/PAN, bank details, invoice numbering and terms, contact info, content playbook, caption prompt). Creates defaults if missing. Any logged-in session.

actions.name: agency_settings_update
actions.desc: Update org agency settings. p_patch keys: legal_name, trade_name, app_name, brand_primary, brand_secondary, address_line_1/2, city, state, pincode, country, gstin, pan, bank_* fields, upi_id, logo_url, signatory_name/designation, signature_url, invoice_terms, default_gst_rate, default_hsn_sac, invoice_prefix/padding, next_invoice_number, credit_note_*, contact_email, contact_phone, content_playbook, caption_prompt_default, invoice_email_template. Admin/manager only (_require_billing_role).

actions.name: home_layout_save
actions.desc: Save the caller's Home page card layout (p_cards = array of card configs). Any staff.

actions.name: org_contact_phone_set
actions.desc: Save the org's contact phone number (normalized). Admin only, own org.

actions.name: org_task_settings_get
actions.desc: Org task settings: task id prefix, work days, work hours per day, holidays and feature toggles (ClickApps). Any staff.

actions.name: org_task_settings_set
actions.desc: Update org task settings. p_patch keys: task_prefix (1-6 A-Z0-9), work_days[] (1-7), work_hours_per_day, holidays[] (dates), features {toggle: bool}. Admin only.

actions.name: platform_orgs_list
actions.desc: Platform-owner Tenants console: list every tenant org with plan, status, trial/period end, payment overdue flag, billing exemption, client and seat counts and admin email. Platform owner only.

actions.name: platform_provision_tenant
actions.desc: Platform owner creates a new tenant org (pre-verified) with its first admin account and a plan. Args: p_org_name, p_admin_email, p_admin_name, p_plan (default starter), p_phone. Platform owner only.

actions.name: platform_set_billing_exempt
actions.desc: Platform owner marks a tenant org billing-exempt (comped) or not; comping unlocks an org locked for non-payment. Platform owner only.

actions.name: platform_set_org_status
actions.desc: Platform owner sets a tenant org's status: trialing, active, past_due, suspended or cancelled (suspend locks the tenant out). Platform owner only.

actions.name: wa_config_get
actions.desc: Get the org's WhatsApp notification config (provider, business number, templates, which events notify, upcoming-task reminder settings). Admin/manager only.

actions.name: wa_config_set
actions.desc: Update the org's WhatsApp config. Admin only. p_data keys: enabled, provider, phone_number_id, business_number, lang, tpl_assigned, tpl_followup, tpl_completed, aisensy_campaign_*, notify_min_priority, notify_direct, notify_posts, notify_completed, app_url, upcoming_enabled, upcoming_types, upcoming_allday_time, upcoming_day_before, upcoming_timed_before_minutes, upcoming_max_per_member_day.

actions.name: attachments_recent
actions.desc: Recent file attachments on tasks the caller can see: name, url, mime, size, task title, uploader. p_limit (default 20, max 100).

actions.name: comments_assigned
actions.desc: List task comments assigned to the caller (p_mode 'assigned', default) or that the caller assigned to others (p_mode 'delegated') in the last 90 days, with task title and client; p_include_resolved adds resolved ones. Any staff; visibility-filtered.

actions.name: leave_cover_list
actions.desc: Needs-cover list: team members on approved leave today through next week with their tasks at risk in that window and any cover task. Admin/manager only.

actions.name: lineup_add
actions.desc: Add a task to the caller's LineUp ('Up next' priority list). Any staff, visible tasks only.

actions.name: lineup_get
actions.desc: Get the caller's LineUp ('Up next' ordered task list) as task rows. Any staff.

actions.name: lineup_remove
actions.desc: Remove a task from the caller's LineUp ('Up next' list); the task itself is untouched. Any staff.

actions.name: lineup_set
actions.desc: Replace the caller's LineUp ('Up next' list) with the given ordered task ids. Any staff, visible tasks only.

actions.name: project_milestone_delete
actions.desc: Delete a project milestone by id. Admin/manager only.

actions.name: project_milestone_upsert
actions.desc: Create or update a project milestone for a client (project-mode clients). Admin/manager only. p_data keys: id (omit to create), client_id, name, status, owner, seq, due_date, notes. Returns the milestone row.

actions.name: project_milestones_seed
actions.desc: Seed the default project milestone set for a client and return all of that client's milestones ordered by seq. Admin/manager only; client must be in the caller's org.

actions.name: reminder_add
actions.desc: Set a personal 'Remind me' reminder on a task the caller can see, at p_remind_at with an optional note; delivered later as an inbox notification. Any staff.

actions.name: reminder_delete
actions.desc: Delete one of the caller's own task reminders by id. Any staff (own reminders only).

actions.name: reminders_list
actions.desc: List the caller's own task reminders (id, task_id, task_title, remind_at, note, sent_at); unsent only unless p_include_sent=true, last 30 days. Any staff.

actions.name: replies_list
actions.desc: Task comment threads the caller is part of (author, mentioned or assigned a comment): task title, last comment preview, unread count. p_unread_only (default true), p_limit.

actions.name: replies_mark_read
actions.desc: Mark a task's comment thread as read for the caller (p_task_id).

actions.name: task_activity_feed
actions.desc: Recent task activity feed (status changes, comments, field edits) across the workspace, limited to tasks the caller may see. p_filter keys: client_id, list_id, member_id, since, limit.

actions.name: task_attachment_add
actions.desc: Attach an already-uploaded file to a task. p_file keys: url, name, path, mime, size. Any staff who can view the task.

actions.name: task_attachment_delete
actions.desc: Remove an attachment from a task. Requires edit rights on the task.

actions.name: task_bootstrap
actions.desc: One-call bootstrap for the task UI: me, members (with presence), clients, lists, statuses, tags, custom fields, org task settings and the caller's prefs. Also lazily creates the system lists. Any staff.

actions.name: task_bulk_update
actions.desc: Apply the same patch to many tasks at once (p_ids uuid[]). p_patch takes the task_update keys (status, priority, due_at, start_at, assignee_ids, assignee_ids_add/remove, list_id, tag_ids, archived...) or {delete:true} to trash them all. Per-task permission checks; returns {updated, failed[]}.

actions.name: task_checklist_add
actions.desc: Add a named checklist to a task. Requires edit rights on the task.

actions.name: task_checklist_delete
actions.desc: Delete a checklist (and its items) from a task. Requires edit rights on the task.

actions.name: task_checklist_item_add
actions.desc: Add an item (p_text) to a task checklist. Requires edit rights on the task.

actions.name: task_checklist_item_delete
actions.desc: Delete a checklist item. Requires edit rights on the task.

actions.name: task_checklist_item_update
actions.desc: Update a checklist item: tick/untick, rename, reorder or assign it (assignee is notified). p_patch keys: text, done, position, assignee_id. Requires edit rights on the task.

actions.name: task_checklist_update
actions.desc: Rename a task checklist (p_name). Requires edit rights on the task.

actions.name: task_close_check
actions.desc: Pre-close check for a task: counts open subtasks, open checklist items, unresolved assigned comments, and lists open tasks blocking it. Use before marking a task done. Any staff who can see it.

actions.name: task_comment_add
actions.desc: Post a comment on a task (optionally a threaded reply via p_parent_id, @mentions via p_mentions uuid[], an assigned comment via p_assigned_to, attachments jsonb). Notifies mentioned/assigned people and watchers. Any staff who can view the task.

actions.name: task_comment_delete
actions.desc: Delete a task comment. Only the comment's author or admin/manager.

actions.name: task_comment_react
actions.desc: Toggle an emoji reaction (p_emoji) on a task comment. Any staff who can view the task.

actions.name: task_comment_update
actions.desc: Edit a task comment, reassign it, or resolve it. p_patch keys: body, assigned_to, resolved (bool). Notifies a newly assigned person.

actions.name: task_create
actions.desc: Create a task (or post/subtask) in the unified task system. p_data keys: title (required), type, client_id, list_id, parent_id, description, status, priority (1-4), due_at, start_at, due_has_time, assignee_ids[], post_type, estimate_minutes, tag_ids[], custom_fields, recurrence, is_private. Returns the new task row; assignees are notified.

actions.name: task_delete
actions.desc: Move a task to trash (soft delete, restorable). Allowed for admin/manager, the task's creator, or editors/designers on post tasks.

actions.name: task_description_history
actions.desc: List previous versions of a task's description (for restore). Any staff who can see the task.

actions.name: task_description_restore
actions.desc: Restore a task description from a saved version (p_version_id). Requires edit rights on the task.

actions.name: task_duplicate
actions.desc: Duplicate a task including its subtasks and checklists; returns the new task row. Any staff who can see the original.

actions.name: task_field_delete
actions.desc: Delete a custom field definition and its values from all tasks. Admin/manager only.

actions.name: task_field_upsert
actions.desc: Create or update a custom task field definition. Admin/manager/seo. p_data keys: id, list_id (null = workspace-wide), name, type, options, position.

actions.name: task_followup_add
actions.desc: Schedule automatic WhatsApp follow-up nudges to a task's assignees. p_data keys: kind ('at' | 'every' | 'before_due'), at (timestamp, kind=at), every_minutes (>=30) + start_at (kind=every), before_minutes (>=5, kind=before_due). Max 10 per task; task editor or creator.

actions.name: task_followup_delete
actions.desc: Cancel a scheduled WhatsApp follow-up on a task. Task editor or creator.

actions.name: task_followups_list
actions.desc: List the scheduled WhatsApp follow-ups on a task. Any staff who can see the task.

actions.name: task_get
actions.desc: Full detail for one task: row + description, subtasks, checklists, attachments, comments, activity, time entries, watchers, custom fields, links, status history, reminders. Marks comments read. Only if the caller may see the task (admin/manager see all).

actions.name: task_id_for_legacy
actions.desc: Map a legacy record id to its unified task id. p_kind: 'content' (post), 'direct' (direct task) or 'milestone'. Returns null if not visible to the caller.

actions.name: task_link_add
actions.desc: Link two tasks. p_kind: 'relates', 'blocks' (this blocks other) or 'waiting_on' (other blocks this); dependency cycles are refused. Requires edit rights on p_task_id and visibility of p_other_id.

actions.name: task_link_delete
actions.desc: Remove a relationship/dependency link between tasks. Requires edit rights on the task.

actions.name: task_links_for
actions.desc: Get relationship/dependency links for several tasks (p_task_ids uuid[]). Only visible tasks.

actions.name: task_list_delete
actions.desc: Delete a task list (system lists cannot be deleted). Admin/manager or the list's creator.

actions.name: task_list_upsert
actions.desc: Create or update a task list (folder of tasks, optionally per client). p_data keys: id, client_id, name, color, icon, position, archived. Any staff except accounts_head; personal lists only by their owner.

actions.name: task_restore
actions.desc: Restore a trashed task (and write back to its legacy record); restored at top level if its parent is still deleted. Admin/manager only.

actions.name: task_set_assignees
actions.desc: Replace a task's assignees with p_member_ids uuid[] (new assignees are notified). Requires edit rights on the task.

actions.name: task_status_delete
actions.desc: Delete a custom status from a list, moving its tasks to p_replace_key. Admin/manager only; content (post) lists have fixed statuses.

actions.name: task_status_upsert
actions.desc: Create or update a custom status on a general task list. Admin/manager only. p_data keys: id, list_id, name, color, category ('todo' | 'active' | 'done'), position.

actions.name: task_tag_delete
actions.desc: Delete a workspace task tag (removed from all tasks). Admin/manager only.

actions.name: task_tag_merge
actions.desc: Merge one task tag into another: every task with the source tag gets the target tag instead, then the source tag is deleted. Admin/manager only. Returns {ok, tasks_updated}.

actions.name: task_tag_upsert
actions.desc: Create or rename/recolor a workspace task tag. p_data keys: id, name, color. Any staff.

actions.name: task_team_set
actions.desc: Assign a task to teams, replacing the current set (p_team_ids uuid[]); members of newly added teams get an inbox notification. Requires edit rights on the task.

actions.name: task_teams_for
actions.desc: Get the teams assigned to each of several tasks (p_task_ids uuid[]). Only visible tasks.

actions.name: task_update
actions.desc: Update one task. p_patch keys: title, description, status, priority, start_at, due_at, due_has_time, keep_duration, shift_dependents, estimate_minutes, list_id, parent_id, tag_ids[], custom_fields, recurrence, is_private, position, archived, type, assignee_ids[], assignee_ids_add[], assignee_ids_remove[]. Requires edit rights; returns the updated row.

actions.name: task_view_delete
actions.desc: Delete a saved task view. Owner, or admin/manager for non-private views.

actions.name: task_view_upsert
actions.desc: Create or update a saved task view (list/board/calendar/table/gantt config). p_data keys: id, scope_type, scope_id, name, view_type, config, is_private, is_pinned, is_default, is_protected, position.

actions.name: task_watch
actions.desc: Start (p_on=true) or stop watching a task to get its notifications. Any staff who can see the task.

actions.name: task_whatsapp_nudge
actions.desc: Send an immediate WhatsApp nudge about a task to all its assignees (except the caller), with an optional note. Requires WhatsApp enabled for the org; any staff who can see the task.

actions.name: tasks_import
actions.desc: Bulk-import tasks into a list from rows (p_rows jsonb array). Row keys: title, description, priority (1-4 or urgent/high/normal/low), status (key or name), assignees (names/emails), tags (created if missing), custom_fields (by field name), estimate_minutes, due_at, start_at.

actions.name: tasks_query
actions.desc: Main task search/list. Non-admin/manager callers only get tasks they are part of. p_filter keys: scope ('all' | 'my' | 'delegated' | 'personal' | 'watching'), list_ids, client_ids, agency_only, assignee_ids, unassigned, types, statuses, status_categories, priorities, tag_ids, due_from, due_to, overdue, no_due, include_closed, top_level, parent_id, search (title or task number), delegated_by ('me' | 'all'), order ('due' | 'priority' | 'created' | 'updated' | 'position' | 'title'), limit, offset. Returns {rows, total}.

actions.name: tasks_recurring_list
actions.desc: List the recurring tasks the caller can see (tasks with a recurrence rule).

actions.name: tasks_trash_list
actions.desc: List trashed (soft-deleted) tasks, most recent first, up to p_limit. Admin/manager only.

actions.name: template_apply
actions.desc: Apply a task template: creates the template's task(s) with subtasks and checklists. p_target keys: list_id, parent_id, task_id (apply into an existing task), base_date (dates are offset from it).

actions.name: template_delete
actions.desc: Delete a task template. Admin/manager or the template's creator.

actions.name: template_get
actions.desc: Get one task template with its full payload (tasks, subtasks, checklists).

actions.name: template_list
actions.desc: List task templates in the Template Center (summaries).

actions.name: template_save_from_task
actions.desc: Save an existing task (with subtasks and checklists) as a reusable template named p_name. Any staff who can see the task.

actions.name: template_upsert
actions.desc: Create or update a task template. Admin/manager only. p_data keys: id, kind ('task' | 'list_kit'), name, description, payload (template tasks/subtasks/checklists).

actions.name: whiteboard_sticky_to_task
actions.desc: Turn a sticky note on a whiteboard into a task (via task_create, same permissions and notifications) and link the element to it. p_data is the task_create payload (title, list_id, client_id, assignees, due_at...). Board editors only.

actions.name: member_profile_set
actions.desc: Set a member's profile: p_patch keys job_title, reports_to, weekly_hours. Admin/manager for anyone; others may only set their own job_title.

actions.name: member_status_set
actions.desc: Set the caller's own status message (p_text, p_emoji) and optional do-not-disturb until p_dnd_until.

actions.name: people_list
actions.desc: Team directory with workload: each member's role, job title, manager, teams, capacity, open/overdue tasks, done this week and open estimate minutes. Any staff; task counts limited to tasks the caller can see.

actions.name: sevak_team_day
actions.desc: Who is present, half day, on leave or not marked on a day (p_date, default today): name, role, attendance, check-in/out times, leave details. Admin/manager only.

actions.name: team_analytics
actions.desc: Team workload analytics over the last p_days (default 7): open, overdue and done counts, per-member breakdown and daily done trend; one team (p_team_id) or all.

actions.name: team_delete
actions.desc: Delete a team (group of members). Admin/manager only.

actions.name: team_set_members
actions.desc: Replace a team's member list (p_member_ids uuid[]). Admin/manager or the team's lead.

actions.name: team_tasks
actions.desc: Tasks assigned to the caller's teams (for My Work). p_filter keys: team_ids, include_closed, exclude_assigned_to_me, limit. Non-admin/manager only see teams they belong to or lead.

actions.name: team_upsert
actions.desc: Create or update a team. p_data keys: id, name, description, color, icon, lead_id, parent_id, member_ids[], position. Admin/manager; a team lead may rename/describe and manage members but not change lead or parent.

actions.name: teams_list
actions.desc: List the org's teams with lead and members.

actions.name: tm_create_client_login
actions.desc: Create a client-portal login (role client) for a brand. Admin/manager only. p_data keys: email, name, client_id, initials, color, is_primary_for_brand, client_member_name, client_designation. Fails if an active member already uses the email.

actions.name: tm_revoke_member
actions.desc: Offboard a team member: status revoked, email and password cleared, all live sessions killed. Admin only.

actions.name: tm_save_staff
actions.desc: Create (or re-save) a staff member login with a role. Admin only; enforces plan seat limits. p_data keys: name, email, role_level (admin/manager/accounts_head/seo/editor/designer/freelancer), role, password, password_salt, password_algo, initials, color.

actions.name: tm_set_role
actions.desc: Change a team member's role_level (admin/manager/accounts_head/seo/editor/designer/freelancer); clears a stale custom role and writes an audit entry. Admin only.

actions.name: tm_update_client_login
actions.desc: Update a client-portal login's email and contact name/designation. Admin/manager; only touches client-role rows. p_data keys: email, client_member_name, client_designation.

actions.name: tm_update_member
actions.desc: Edit a team member's name, email, initials or capacity (role and password not editable here). Admin only. p_data keys: name, email, initials, capacity.

actions.name: att_checkout
actions.desc: Stamp the caller's attendance check-out (sign-off) for today; no-op if not checked in or already out. Usually called on logout.

actions.name: att_mark
actions.desc: Mark the caller's own attendance for today. p_status: 'present' | 'half_day' | 'absent' | 'leave'; present/half_day also start the clock. Once a day, self only; fails on an off day. Returns {already, status, check_in_at, check_out_at}.

actions.name: att_today
actions.desc: Today's attendance state for the caller: date, whether it is an off day, and their marked row if any.

actions.name: leave_report_unplanned
actions.desc: Report the caller as off (unplanned leave): records leave and attendance for the days (p_from/p_to, default today; p_half for half day; p_reason) and creates a cover task for brand managers/admins listing work at risk. Any staff (not clients).

actions.name: task_time_add
actions.desc: Log a manual time entry on a task: p_minutes, optional p_date (default today IST) and p_note. Any staff who can view the task.

actions.name: task_time_delete
actions.desc: Delete a time entry. Own entries, or any entry for admin/manager.

actions.name: task_time_start
actions.desc: Start the caller's running timer on a task (stops any other running timer first).

actions.name: task_time_stop
actions.desc: Stop the caller's currently running task timer and save the entry.

actions.name: time_entries_list
actions.desc: List time entries. p_filter keys: member_ids, client_ids, task_ids, from, to (YYYY-MM-DD inclusive), billable, approved, invoiced, limit (<=5000). Non admin/manager/accounts_head see only their own entries.

actions.name: time_entry_add
actions.desc: Log a time entry. p_data keys: task_id, minutes, date (default today IST), note, billable (default true), member_id (admin/manager only, to log for someone else).

actions.name: time_entry_delete
actions.desc: Delete a time entry. Own entries until submitted/approved/invoiced; admin/manager any non-invoiced entry.

actions.name: time_entry_update
actions.desc: Edit a time entry. p_patch keys: minutes, date, note, billable, task_id. Own entries until submitted/approved/invoiced; admin/manager any non-invoiced entry.

actions.name: time_estimate_vs_tracked
actions.desc: Estimated vs tracked minutes per task. p_filter keys: scope ('my' | 'all'; all needs admin/manager/accounts_head), client_ids, include_closed, limit (<=200).

actions.name: time_report
actions.desc: Time report grouped by member, client, task or day. p_filter keys: from, to (default this week), group_by ('member' | 'client' | 'task' | 'day'), member_ids, client_ids, billable, approved. Amounts/rates only for admin/manager/accounts_head; others see only their own time.

actions.name: timesheet_review
actions.desc: Review a submitted weekly timesheet. p_action: 'approve', 'reject' (p_note required) or 'reopen'. Admin/manager only; a manager cannot review their own. Notifies the member.

actions.name: timesheet_submit
actions.desc: Submit the caller's weekly timesheet (week of p_week_start) for approval, with an optional note.

actions.name: timesheet_week_get
actions.desc: Get a weekly timesheet grid (tasks x days, totals, status). Caller's own week, or a member's (p_member_id) for admin/manager/accounts_head.

actions.name: timesheet_week_save
actions.desc: Save the caller's weekly timesheet grid. p_cells: array of {task_id, date, minutes (day total for that task), billable?, note?}; p_task_ids keeps row order. Locked once submitted/approved; returns the week plus any clamped 'adjusted' cells.

actions.name: timesheet_withdraw
actions.desc: Withdraw the caller's submitted (not yet approved) timesheet for the week of p_week_start back to draft. Self only.

actions.name: timesheets_list
actions.desc: List weekly timesheets for review. p_filter keys: from, to (default last 8 weeks), statuses[] ('draft' | 'submitted' | 'approved' | 'rejected' | 'missing'), member_ids, include_missing.

actions.name: timesheets_pending_count
actions.desc: Count of submitted timesheets awaiting review (badge count). Admin/manager only (others get 0); managers don't count their own.
